integrity: The all-degree proof is given directly and the finite verifier is reproducible with the Python standard library. Prior generator equivalence and functional-digraph facts are acknowledged; no external validation or publication priority is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact counts apply to labeled full transformation monoids with ambient identity, not conjugacy classes or all semigroups. The uniform asymptotic estimate is not claimed optimal. General literature coverage cannot be certified exhaustively. Finite checks reach degree six and are not a universal proof.
title: Embedded monogenic transformation monoids: a joint threshold, period, and stable-rank census
